'''Rolf Petruma''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[President/Legends|president]] of [[Freda]]. He had been involved with talks with his counterpart from [[Jante]] over disputed mining rights in the [[Rettna system/Legends|Rettna system]] at the behest of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Haveland/Legends|Haveland]]. Dissatisfied with the negotiations, Petruma withdrew from the talks and authorized [[Battle of the Rettna system|military action]] against Jante holdings in the Rettna system.
